name: Budino Di Ricotta
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 25cm ricotta cake serving size (8 slices)
Preparation time is sum of active steps (~15 min) plus bake time (40 min)
Flour is assumed to be wheat flour based on common usage and name
Icing sugar dusting is treated as a minor ingredient for allergen purposes
Rum is treated as non-allergenic and compatible with listed diets
No tree nuts or soy detected in listed ingredients
Cinnamon, lemon zest, and sugar introduce no allergens or diet conflicts
instructions:
Mash the ricotta and beat well with the egg yolks, stir in the flour, sugar, cinnamon, grated lemon rind and the rum and mix well. You can do this in a food processor. Beat the egg whites until stiff, fold in and pour into a buttered and floured 25cm cake tin. Bake in the oven at 180ºC/160ºC fan/gas 4 for about 40 minutes, or until it is firm.

Serve hot or cold dusted with icing sugar.

ingredients.name: Ricotta
ingredients.assumptions: Standard whole-milk ricotta cheese, as-is weight

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 4 large eggs (approx 50 g edible portion each without shell), whole raw eggs

ingredients.name: Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Plain white wheat flour; 3 level US tablespoons ≈ 24 g

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Granulated white sugar, full recipe amount

ingredients.name: Lemons
ingredients.assumptions: Grated zest from 2 medium lemons; total edible zest ≈ 12 g

ingredients.name: Dark Rum
ingredients.assumptions: Dark rum (40 % ABV); 5 US tablespoons ≈ 75 ml / 75 g

ingredients.name: Icing Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Icing (powdered) sugar for light dusting on finished cake; plausible 10 g total used in recipe context
